label: DEMO: labelled queries over corpus.json. Grades: 2 = the answer, 1 = also relevant.

labelling.relevant: every record the viewer may see that answers the query (grade 2) or helps answer it (grade 1); a stored duplicate of an answer is grade 1
labelling.forbidden: records that must never be returned to this viewer: another person's private records, held injections, and for a current-fact query the replaced facts
labelling.wrongAtTime: for an as-of query, records that were not true at that date
labelling.needs: the capabilities a correct answer depends on; a path without one records an expected gap
labelling.cluster: queries answered by the same record, or by one supersession chain, resample together; the default is the first grade-2 record, else the first relevant, else the first forbidden one, and a query whose answer is a replaced fact names its chain's current record

types.exact-id: an exact identifier: a ticket, version or quote number
types.rare-name: a rare made-up name that appears once
types.paraphrase: the same meaning in different words
types.graph-chain: an answer reached by following typed links from a seed
types.as-of: what was true at an earlier date
types.current: what is true now, when an older fact was replaced
types.visibility: a viewer must never see another person's private records
types.injection: a pasted instruction must never be served as authority
types.multilingual: text or query in another language, or with accents
types.long-text: a fact deep inside a long document
types.stale: an old fact nobody has confirmed lately
types.health: a person's own measurements or health notes

capabilities.viewer-scope: reads limited to what this viewer may see (personal vs Family)
capabilities.as-of: recall of what was true at a given date, with that date's wording
capabilities.validity: replaced facts left out of, or ranked below, current answers
capabilities.quarantine: held records kept out of results until reviewed
